questions.prompt: Which Figma seat lets you write to Figma files with agents?

options.explanation: Figma says Dev seats can use the server for read-only workflows.
Right. Figma says you need a Full seat, plus edit permission to change an existing file.
Figma names the Full seat for writes and the Dev seat for read-only work. The page names no other seat.

questions.prompt: In Canva's MCP editing flow, what happens to edits that are never committed?

options.text: They are saved after a short wait
options.explanation: Nothing saves by itself. Only a commit with status committed saves.

options.text: They go live for viewers only
options.explanation: Canva says edits stay in draft until you commit, and uncommitted edits are discarded.
Right. Canva says: if the transaction isn't committed, the edits are discarded.

questions.prompt: You want to add a new photo in a Canva editing operation. What comes first?

options.text: Upload it with upload-asset-from-url and use the asset_id
options.explanation: Right. Canva says not to pass a raw image URL into an editing operation.

options.text: Paste the raw image URL straight into the operation
options.explanation: Canva says not to do this. Upload first to get an asset_id.

options.text: Export the design as PNG, then add the photo to it
options.explanation: An export is a static file. It cannot take an editing operation.
